overview.title: The showcase of Moroccan pottery
overview.p1: Safi is Morocco's pottery capital. The National Ceramics Museum presents collections, techniques and the history of this craft.
overview.p2: The visit ideally pairs with the potters' quarter, where kilns and workshops are still active.
overview.p3: Check opening hours before you go.
